{"code":"def transform(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
 # locate colored non-2 marker
 mr=mc=None; col=9
 for r in range(h):
  for c in range(w):
   if grid[r][c] not in (0,2): mr,mc,col=r,c,grid[r][c]
 # canonical pattern relative to upper-left colored marker
 P=[[0,0,0,9,9,9,0,0,0],[0,0,9,9,9,0,0,0,0],[0,9,9,9,9,0,0,0,0],[9,9,9,9,9,9,0,0,0],[9,9,0,0,9,9,9,0,0],[9,0,0,0,0,9,9,9,0],[0,0,0,0,0,0,9,9,9],[0,0,0,0,0,0,0,9,9],[0,0,0,0,0,0,0,0,9]]
 # marker orientation: colored cell is lower-left => vertical flip
 flip=False
 if mr is not None and mr+1<h and grid[mr+1][mc]==2: flip=True
 for r in range(h):
  for c in range(w):
   dr=r-mr; dc=c-mc
   pr=dr+1 if not flip else 7-dr
   pc=dc+3
   if 0<=pr<9 and 0<=pc<9 and P[pr][pc]: out[r][c]=col
 return out"}
